title: The 60-Day Money Check-In: Is Your Plan Working?

lines.say: Two months into the year. Is your plan working?
Let's check our example from episodes one and eighteen, then you do yours, in four questions.
Question one. Is the debt going down?

lines.cap: On the real plan from episode 18 ($373 a month), the card went from $3,200 to $2,576. Down $624 in 60 days.
lines.say: On the real plan from episode eighteen, three seventy-three a month, the card went from thirty-two hundred to twenty-five seventy-six. Down six twenty-four in sixty days.

lines.cap: About $122 of the payments went to interest. That's the cost of carrying the balance, and why every extra dollar matters.
lines.say: About a hundred twenty-two of the payments went to interest. That's the cost of carrying the balance, and why every extra dollar matters.
Question two. Did the surprise fund work?

scene.label: Surprise fund after 4 paychecks
scene.sub: the next oil change is already covered

lines.cap: Two paychecks at $66, then two at $76 after the month-one fix: about $284 saved. In month one, the oil change broke the budget. Next time, it comes out of the fund. That's the system working.
lines.say: Two paychecks at sixty-six, then two at seventy-six after the month-one fix. About two eighty-four saved. In month one, the oil change broke the budget. Next time, it comes out of the fund. That's the system working.
Question three. Is the plan still true?

scene.text: Keeps missing? Change the number, not your willpower.

lines.say: Put planned next to actual again. If a category keeps missing, change the number, not your willpower. Episode eighteen shows how.
Question four. What's the next big move?

lines.cap: For our example, it's the tax refund. Put $1,800 on the card in March, and look what happens.
lines.say: For our example, it's the tax refund. Put eighteen hundred on the card in March, and look what happens.

lines.cap: Debt-free in month 5 instead of 10, and about $163 less interest.
lines.say: Debt-free in month five instead of ten, and about a hundred sixty less interest.
Debt going down? Surprise fund working?
Plan still true? And what's the next big move?

scene.text: Mostly yes? You're ahead of most January budgets.

lines.say: If the answers are mostly yes, you're doing better than most people who started a budget in January. Keep going.

scene.cta: Do your check-in with the Paycheck Planner: link in the description

lines.say: The Paycheck Planner in the description makes the check-in a five-minute job.
